description: Deliver the direct Workflow mohist/pi path on the existing Action and AgentSession contracts: pin and verify Pi, implement PiRuntime, make Workflow bindings runtime-aware, serialize logical Session turns in process, report Pi facts through the current binding-validated route, and expose them in existing Session views.

tasks.title: Pin Pi SDK and verify its runtime contract
tasks.description: Pin the Pi SDK and supported Node release, then verify the real integration surface before product implementation. Record a sanitized smoke artifact and reconcile any API drift into the canonical Pi design.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/runner/package.json pins @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to an exact version and package-lock.json is updated through the Runner workspace npm command; no ACP/RPC dependency is added

Root and Runner engines require Node >=22.19; .nvmrc pins a concrete compatible release; CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/self-host.md name the supported minimum; every setup-node workflow and Docker build path uses an explicit compatible version

sdk-smoke-verification.json records the pinned package/Node versions and sanitized results for service/catalog setup, project-untrusted resources, Session create/open, absolute sessionFile, agent-session creation, literal prompt/messages/events, stable message/tool identities, setModel, setThinkingLevel, steer, abort, and stop confirmation
The smoke proves repository .pi execution resources are excluded while global Pi configuration and repository instruction context retain their specified roles
The smoke proves an allowed tool call can complete headlessly without a per-tool approval wait
Any verified SDK drift is reflected in design/runtimes/pi.md and openspec/changes/issue-450/design.md before T-002 begins
A repository-wide Node-version search accounts for every active manifest, version pin, source-install document, CI workflow, and Docker declaration, and none can select a pre-22.19 release
A clean npm ci on the supported Node release and npm run typecheck -w packages/runner pass without leaving Git-visible changes
tasks.output: Pinned Runner dependency, repository-wide Node toolchain/documentation updates, sdk-smoke-verification.json, and any evidence-driven Pi call-map correction
tasks.notes: This is the only real-SDK task. Do not begin runtime product code from an unverified 0.x API. The artifact must never include credentials, prompts, messages, auth-file content, or raw provider responses. AgentJob, Session commands, and catalog reporting remain out of scope.

tasks.title: Implement the in-process PiRuntime module
tasks.description: Create the deep runtime/pi module with SDK isolation, readiness, untrusted project resources, physical Session create/open/cache/dispose, literal prompt completion, unattended tools, per-turn model/thinking, normalized events, deterministic deadline/cancellation, and provider failure policy.
acceptanceCriteria: All Pi SDK imports and upstream event shapes are confined to packages/runner/src/runtime/pi; callers and tests use Mohist-owned request/result/event/error types
start/ready/diagnostic gate readiness on service and catalog initialization; an empty catalog is ready with a warning, while failure is not-ready and retryable
The SDK factory fixes project trust false, excludes repository .pi execution resources, preserves repository instruction context, and offers no caller override

Sentinel-credential tests prove SDK/provider values do not enter Mohist request/result types, registration, runtime events, task logs, diagnostics, Action output, or smoke-shaped evidence; existing credential masking is applied before text sinks
createSession returns a normalized absolute session-file path; restore opens the exact bound path; missing/corrupt paths return missing-session without implicit creation

runTurn applies model/thinking on the existing Session, submits slash-prefixed text literally, awaits prompt() as the sole completion authority, reconciles final messages, and never performs a second wait or automatic replay
Tool-loop tests prove no approval callback or confirmation state blocks unattended completion

The event projector covers assistant/reasoning, tools, model/status, input/output/cache-read/cache-write/thought usage, cost/currency, stable-ID idempotency, final-message reconciliation, and diagnostic-only unknown events
Fake-clock tests cover one wrap-up steer, deadline result fixation before abort, late completion, external interruption, and stop-unconfirmed diagnostics

The existing provider failure defaults are extracted to one runtime-neutral pure policy used by OpenCode and Pi; provider tests cover default and valid non-default injection, invalid policy rejection, immediate quota/billing failure, retries below threshold, threshold failure, Pi terminal errors, binding preservation, and no replay
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner and npm test -w packages/runner pass using fake SDK services and fake time only
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/runtime/pi deep module with deterministic fake-backed tests
tasks.notes: Do not add a generic AgentRuntime, AgentJob execution, Session commands, Action reporting/outbox code, or Pi catalog publication.

tasks.title: Make Workflow AgentSession binding runtime-aware
tasks.description: Extend only Workflow Session open/attach with explicit runtime and guarded expected-current binding semantics. Register Pi for persistence/events, preserve logical identity and lineage, carry cache-write usage, and keep current command and historical Reset behavior intact.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow Session open requires runtime opencode or pi, returns observed runtime/physical binding/workDir, and generic AgentJob open routes remain OpenCode-only
Workflow attach carries target runtime plus expected current runtime and physical ID; first attach and identical repeat succeed idempotently
The required Workflow wire change atomically migrates the existing mohist/opencode open/attach caller and regression-tests OpenCode reuse plus OpenCode-to-Pi and Pi-to-OpenCode guarded transitions
An expected cross-runtime attach preserves logical ID/source/workDir and appends one lineage entry, while stale expected state and same-runtime different IDs are rejected atomically
Work-directory mismatch is rejected before binding change, and stale runtime-event batches are rejected by current physical ID before Session state changes

AgentSession recognizes pi for storage and event admission; Pi-bound Follow-up, Compact, Reset, and Cancel admission returns unavailable without reservation, Runner dispatch, OpenCode invocation, or binding mutation, while the existing Reset fallback for unregistered historical runtimes remains unchanged
cachedWriteTokens is added append-only through Session domain state/surrogates, runtime-event parsing, API/read contracts, and shared generated/manual types without merging it into cachedReadTokens
Existing costAmount/costCurrency fields accept Pi cost facts without a parallel cost model

Server unit/spec coverage includes first/idempotent attach, guarded runtime change and lineage, stale race, same-runtime replacement rejection, workDir mismatch, missing defaults, Pi registration, command admission, historical Reset fallback, stale events, cache-write, cost, and reactivation
npm test, npm run typecheck -w packages/runner, and npm test -w packages/runner pass with no real external dependency or wall clock in new tests
tasks.output: Runtime-aware Workflow AgentSession API/domain transitions, atomic OpenCode caller migration, and Pi-compatible usage contracts with Server/Runner coverage
tasks.notes: This SDK-independent task may run beside T-001, but it must migrate the currently working OpenCode wire atomically. Do not add Runner authentication, Action streams, event sequence/cursor state, AgentJob Pi routing, or Pi command handlers. Preserve the existing unknown-runtime Reset fallback exactly.

tasks.title: Serialize logical Workflow Session turns in task and check hosts
tasks.description: Add one RunnerHost-owned process-local coordinator and acquire it from both Workflow task and check hosts around the complete Inline Agent Action turn, including task cleanup. The key is logical Session identity and is shared by OpenCode and Pi.
acceptanceCriteria: One WorkflowSessionTurnCoordinator instance is shared by WorkExecutor task and check execution paths and keyed by projectId, workflowRunId, and normalized session name; one runtime-neutral helper supplies exactly the same name to coordinator and Action binding
The task lease spans initial Action invocation and any worktree-cleanup reinvocation; the check lease spans its complete Action invocation
Concurrent task/check or OpenCode/Pi calls for one key execute sequentially, while different keys execute concurrently
Queue tails are removed after settlement and failures do not poison later work
The coordinator stores no runtime binding, Session command, event, credential, authentication, durable recovery, or cross-process state

Runner tests cover same-session ordering across task/check and runtimes, cleanup exclusion, different-session concurrency, rejection/failure cleanup, and omitted-session Work ID keys with controllable promises rather than wall time
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner and npm test -w packages/runner pass
tasks.output: Process-local Workflow Session turn coordinator integrated with task, check, and cleanup hosts
tasks.notes: This SDK-independent task may run beside T-001. It is deliberately a narrow in-process concurrency boundary, not a distributed lock or recovery protocol. Do not move Session lifecycle or runtime-specific state into it.

tasks.title: Deliver mohist/pi through Workflow completion and Session reporting
tasks.description: Wire PiRuntime into RunnerHost and ActionContext, register mohist/pi, connect runtime-aware Session binding and the existing runtime-event route, and carry successful final text through the existing task/check, promise, recovery, and cleanup paths.
acceptanceCriteria: RunnerHost starts/shuts down PiRuntime, retries failed startup, gates new polling on OpenCode and Pi readiness, and does not publish Pi models in the OpenCode catalog payload

mohist/pi is registered for tasks and checks, accepts only resolved prompt/session/options.model/options.variant, defaults omitted session to Work ID, fixes the Runner-private Prompt duration at 60 minutes with no Action override, and has no hidden vars.agent or named-Agent lookup
TaskRun/dispatch/YAML/parent-context classification uses an explicit Inline Agent Action set containing mohist/opencode and mohist/pi rather than substring matching
A first turn opens the logical Session, rejects workDir mismatch, creates Pi, persists its absolute path with the expected-current guard, reports session.input, and only then submits the prompt
Same-name task/check/retry/restart/model-change turns reuse the binding; missing files fail with runtime-session-missing and Reset guidance; cleanup reuses the same path under the original task lease

Pi facts are buffered only in memory for the current turn and sent in order through workflowAgentSessionRuntimeEvents with the current physical ID; required input and final assistant/reasoning/tool/model/status/usage/cost facts flush before success

Any required reporting write/flush failure returns session-reporting-failed and bypasses completion evaluation; no outbox, stream, cursor, inventory, checkpoint, background success, or prompt replay is introduced

Successful final text reaches task _output evaluation only through private turnFact; task output is null or exactly {promise}; checks use the same Action and normal host pass/fail mapping without Pi-specific output interpretation

Until issue #447 replaces current Action plumbing, runtime-bearing ActionContext and name-based promise/cleanup classification are extended only as an explicitly documented temporary gap; no competing Action host abstraction is introduced

Runtime error mapping covers invalid input, unavailable runtime, missing Session, workspace/binding failure, incompatible runtime, timeout, interruption, provider turn failure, and reporting failure while preserving binding

Fake-backed end-to-end specs cover task and check dispatch, open/create/bind/input/prompt/events/final flush, expectation/promise, same-session serialization, retry/restart reuse, model changes, missing file, cleanup, timeout, provider failure, reporting failure, stale events, and no replay
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner, npm test -w packages/runner, and npm test pass
tasks.output: End-to-end direct Workflow mohist/pi Action across Runner and Server with fake-backed product-path coverage
tasks.notes: Use the existing binding-validated AgentSession event route. The manifest agent-turn target remains owned by issue #447. AgentJob, Pi Session commands, runtime-aware model catalog/UI, ACP/RPC, durable event replay, and broad transport security are not part of this task.
